description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Arixmethes.
Repeat.

uses.cardState: without a slumber counter on it and without summoning sickness
